GV.SC-01.threat: A supplier's system that already has legitimate access to your data and systems (for example one connected to your ERP to run business processes) may add AI to how it works: a model deciding the next step, or agents and MCP tools acting with that access. GV.SC-05.threat: Contracts were written for a supplier's people and fixed software acting with the access you gave them. Contracts should cover these, and name the model providers and tool services the supplier's AI relies on.

PR.AA-05.threat: Outside AI agents can act on your systems with access your users, customers or partners delegated to them. Unlike a fixed integration, an agent decides what to do itself and can be steered by content it reads, so it may use everything that access allows, at machine speed.
